title: What’s running in my GPU cluster?

scenes.heading: What did the last team install?
scenes.sub: The handover only says GPU cluster
voice: You inherit a GPU cluster, and the handover only says it has GPUs.
Before you choose a recipe, find out what is actually running.

scenes.heading: Ask the running cluster
scenes.sub: Capture it against the right kubeconfig
scenes.result: Agent runs as a Kubernetes Job
voice: Run AICR snapshot against the kubeconfig for this cluster.
The CLI starts a Kubernetes Job with the snapshot agent, which reads cluster state and inspects a worker node.

scenes.heading: Read what the agent found
voice: The snapshot records hardware, the operating system and kernel, the Kubernetes version, and installed components.
In this example, the record identifies an H100 rather than leaving the accelerator to guesswork.

scenes.heading: Keep that observation
scenes.sub: Save it for the next decision
voice: Save the snapshot to a file or a Kubernetes ConfigMap.
Use the same observation to supply cluster facts when generating a recipe, then use it again for the readiness check.

payoff: Replace an incomplete handover with a reusable snapshot that records the GPU, node software, and installed components.
